queries: WITH t AS (SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.spent <> 0 GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM t) AS diff_from_mean FROM t;

responses.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.spent <> 0 GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM t) AS diff_from_mean FROM t;

assumptions.assumption: Rows with spent = 0 are excluded. Rows with NULL spent drop out too, since NULL <> 0 is not true. A budget line with amount = 0 gives a NULL ratio (via NULLIF) and is ignored in the average.
'How far from the mean' is the signed difference (type average minus the unweighted mean of the per-type averages). Each type counts equally in that mean, regardless of how many budget lines it has.

alternatives.interpretation: 'How far' means the absolute distance, with no sign.

assumptions.assumption: The difference from the mean of the per-type averages is signed (type average minus the unweighted mean of the type averages). It is not an absolute value.
Lines with a NULL spent or a zero amount give a NULL ratio. AVG ignores these, and the mean of the per-type averages also skips any type whose average is NULL.
Events with a NULL type form their own group.

alternatives.interpretation: The distance is reported as an absolute value, so it has no sign.

responses.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(1.0 * b.spent / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.spent <> 0 GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS diff_from_mean FROM per_type

assumptions.assumption: Lines with amount = 0 give a NULL ratio (SQLite division by zero) and are ignored in the average, as are lines with NULL spent, which fail the spent <> 0 filter.
The 'mean of the per-type averages' is the unweighted mean across event types, taken over the types that have a non-NULL average.
'How far from the mean' is reported as a signed difference (type average minus overall mean), so positive means above the mean.

alternatives.interpretation: 'How far' means the absolute distance from the mean of the per-type averages, with no sign.
